camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeDomainSecureAlarmList --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '139.227.0.0' --Lang zh --From sas
description_en: Queries security alert data from a website security report
description_zh: 查询网站安全报告的安全告警数据
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-domain-secure-alarm-list --source-ip 139.227.0.0 --lang zh --from sas --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainSecureAlarmList

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the request and response messages. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the request source. Set this parameter to sas
parameters.name: from

AlarmList.description_en: The list of security alerts for website assets
AlarmList.description_zh: 网站资产的安全告警列表

items.description_en: The list of security alerts for website assets
items.description_zh: 网站资产的安全告警列表

AlarmEventName.description_en: The name of the alert event

AlarmEventNameOriginal.description_en: The original parent name of the alert event
AlarmEventNameOriginal.description_zh: 告警事件的原始父名称

AlarmEventType.description_en: The type of the alert event

AlarmUniqueInfo.description_en: The unique identifier of the alert event

AutoBreaking.description_en: Indicates whether automatic defense is enabled

CanBeDealOnLine.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert event can be handled online, such as blocking, adding to a whitelist, or ignoring. Valid values:

true: Can be handled online.
false: Cannot be handled online
CanBeDealOnLine.description_zh:
是否能在线处理告警事件，例如阻断隔离、加白名单、忽略等。取值：

true：支持在线处理
false：不支持在线处理

CanCancelFault.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert event can be unmarked as a false positive. Valid values:

true: Can be unmarked.
false: Cannot be unmarked
CanCancelFault.description_zh:
告警事件能否取消标记为误报。取值：

true：可以取消
false：不可以取消

ContainHwMode.description_en: Indicates whether the alert event contains the critical event protection mode

DataSource.description_en: The data source of the alert event

Dealed.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert event has been handled. Valid values:
N: Pending.
Y: Handled
Dealed.description_zh:
要查询的告警事件是否已处理。取值：
N：待处理
Y：已处理

Description.description_en: The description of the alert event
Description.example: The detection model finds that there is a Trojan horse program on your server. The Trojan horse program is a program specially used to invade the user's host. Generally, it will download and release another malicious program after being implanted into the system through disguise.

EndTime.description_en: The timestamp of the most recent occurrence of the alert event. Unit: milliseconds
EndTime.description_zh: 告警事件最新发生的时间戳。单位为毫秒

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the alert event was last modified

HasTraceInfo.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert event has tracing information. Valid values:

true: Has tracing information.
false: Does not have tracing information
HasTraceInfo.description_zh:
告警事件是否有溯源信息。取值：

true：有溯源
false：无溯源

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the asset instance affected by the alert event
InstanceId.description_zh: 受告警事件影响的资产实例的ID

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the asset instance affected by the alert event
InstanceName.description_zh: 受告警事件影响资产实例的名称

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the server

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the asset instance affected by the alert event
IntranetIp.description_zh: 受告警事件影响的资产实例的私网IP

Level.description_en:
The risk level of the alert event. Valid values:
serious: Critical.
suspicious: Suspicious.
remind: Reminder
Level.description_zh:
告警事件的危险等级。取值：
serious：紧急
suspicious：可疑
remind：提醒

OperateErrorCode.description_en: The result code of the alert event handling
OperateErrorCode.description_zh: 告警事件处理的结果码

OperateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the alert event was handled. Unit: milliseconds
OperateTime.description_zh: 告警事件处理的时间戳。单位：毫秒

SaleVersion.description_en:
The edition of Security Center that supports the detection of the alert event. Valid values:
0: Basic edition.
1: Advanced edition.
2: Enterprise edition
SaleVersion.description_zh:
支持检测告警事件的云安全中心的售卖版本。取值：
0：基础版本
1：高级版
2：企业版

SecurityEventIds.description_en: The IDs of the alert events associated with the alert event
SecurityEventIds.description_zh: 告警事件关联的告警事件的ID

Solution.description_en: The solution for the alert event
Solution.example: A malicious program implanted by hacker after intrusion will occupy your bandwidth and attack other servers, and may affect you own service. The malicious process may also have self-deleting behavior or disguise as a system service to evade detection.

Stages.description_en: The stage of the attack or intrusion

StartTime.description_en: The start timestamp of the alert event. Unit: milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 告警事件的开始时间戳，单位为毫秒

SuspiciousEventCount.description_en: The total number of security alerts for your website assets
SuspiciousEventCount.description_zh: 您网站资产中的安全告警总数

Uuid.description_en: The unique identifier of the instance associated with the alert event
Uuid.description_zh: 告警事件关联的实例的唯一标识

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
